simple.meaning: עַרְבָתִי (ʻArbâthîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “an Arbathite or inhabitant of (Beth-) Arabah.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עַרְבָתִי (H6164) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 23:31, with occurrences in 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עַרְבָתִי (H6164) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עַרְבָתִי (H6164) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עַרְבָתִי (ʻArbâthîy) / H6164 is traced through 2 Samuel 23:31, 1 Chronicles 11:32 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
